name: NATS demo issuer (flow)
description: Branching NATS receiver as a participant flow (ADR-0006). The trigger fires on each inbound request on subject demo.auth (via the nats_demo_in connection); the `if` node branches on the amount; the reply node answers the request inbox. This is the flow-graph alternative to the rules-based 'NATS demo issuer' simulator — reach for it when the reply needs logic (branch on the body, call a downstream switch/issuer/HSM via an `action` node, then reply). Import via Simulated Network -> Participant Flows -> Import.
